meta.title: After discarding a draft the vendor can quote from scratch
gaps: The vocabulary has no operation for discarding a draft bid, so the discard step is not checked. HTTP 200 is not asserted because status assertions require a read operation.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
